analysis.title: GS Blekos - Marketcolour + US Earnings Pre Reckitt (Up) Hensoldt (I) Adyen Pre Ferrovial 7 Oct 2026
key_insights: US equities closed higher in a broad-based rally with SPX and NDX at fresh all-time highs: SPX +58bps to 7818 (10 of 11 sectors up, Utilities +3%), NDX +48bps to 31,224, RTY -59bps to 2830, VIX at 15.
Hard disk drive stocks sold off: crowded longs STX and WDC fell 8-10% on another wave of competition concerns (Toshiba), which spilled into semicap equipment (AMAT, KLAC, LRCX).
Biotech fell about 350bps, with AVBP down 46% on a clinical miss.
European equities rose (SXXP +50bps, SX5E +50bps), led by cyclicals (GSXECYCL +90bps). Momentum (+90bps), High Beta (+1%) and Value (+90bps) led factor performance, while Quality lagged (-30bps).

Peter Bartlett attributes the Nasdaq breakout to three drivers: clean positioning (GS PB hedge fund net exposure near a 5-year low, GS Sentiment indicator near multi-year lows), covering of macro products/hedges, and a steady concentration of dollars into Tech/AI at the expense of the rest of the market. Market breadth is at its lowest level since 2000.

US Q3 EPS preview: consensus expects S&P 500 y/y EPS growth of 27%, versus realized growth of 33% in Q2 (excluding some accounting distortions). AI infrastructure beneficiaries account for over 50% of S&P 500 EPS growth this quarter, alongside hyperscaler capex growth of 116%.

Erwan Rambourg initiates luxury coverage: Buy Richemont, LVMH, Moncler and Prada; Sell Hermès and Swatch. He sees 2027 as the turning point, with organic growth returning to mid-single digits as brands address aggressive pricing, limited innovation and strategic inertia. The US stays the key growth engine, China stabilises, the Middle East rebounds, and Europe stays more muted.

Reckitt upgraded to Buy on: core growth accelerating to about 5% over the medium term (EM momentum, innovation such as Mucinex 12hr Cold & Fever, easier cold/flu comps in North America/Europe); group margins rising to about 26% in FY28 and 28% longer term; and stronger FCF from FY27.

Adyen: Conviction Buy, PT cut to EUR1750 from EUR1850 (100% upside). FY26 growth estimate unchanged at 22.2% y/y ex-fx (21.2% organic). 3Q forecast 21.5% ex-fx (19.5% organic), 4Q 23.7% ex-fx (21.9% organic). Shares trade on about 11x/18x/14x CY27E EV/EBITDA, P/E and EV/FCF, a PEG of 0.9x, with 2027-30E CAGRs of 21%/24%/22%/23% for revenue/EBITDA/PF EPS/FCF.

Eurofins: Buy, PT raised to EUR89 from EUR85 (20% upside). Top line remains under pressure, but margin expansion this year was a positive surprise, with upside risk to 2027 margins from IT investment, the hub-and-spoke lab network and portfolio review.

Hensoldt: initiation with PT EUR85. Backlog gives growth visibility and earnings growth is strong, but forecasts are broadly in line with consensus and the premium valuation balances the strong fundamentals.

Ferrovial: shares are down 17% since the winning I-24 bid. Rates explain part of the decline, but investor conversations point to I-24 as a large part of the negative sentiment. The project is 8 years from opening and key financial details are expected after financial close (by Jul-27). Analyst Patrick views the sell-off as overdone and the project as broadly NPV neutral, and sees longer-term value.

US E-Commerce preview (Eric Sheridan): Buy AMZN, CHEWY and PATTERN versus GROUPON. GS work suggests the digital consumer remains resilient despite elevated demand concerns in 2026. Consumers prioritize value, convenience, delivery speed and necessities, with spending growth concentrated among higher-income cohorts.
